summary: Provider refreshes are sequenced, timed out, cancelled when inactive, and failures clear prior health claims. Regression coverage covers failures, empty rosters, ordering, and timeouts.

evidence: static/admin-supervisor.js sequences refresh generations, aborts superseded requests, applies a bounded timeout, and fences every awaited response before rendering.
static/admin-supervisor.js replaces the provider list with an accessible unavailable item for failures and empty provider rosters, including distinct first-load wording.
tests/admin-supervisor-follow.test.ts covers non-2xx responses, malformed and rejected fetches, empty rosters, out-of-order completions, and timeout clearing.
